relationFileList.content: CH344 datasheet, USB to quad serial ports, supports up to 6Mbps baud rate, supports USB parameters configuration, provides RS485 direction control and GPIO and other signal pins. CH344 supports built-in CDC driver in operating system or multi-functional high-speed VCP manufacture driver.

relationFileList.name: CH348DS1.PDF

relationFileList.name: CH9102DS1.PDF
relationFileList.content:
CH9102 datasheet, USB to single serial port, supports up to 4M baud rate, serial port signals support 1.8~5V.
CH9102 provides RS485 control and GPIO signals, built-in crystal oscillator and provides QFN24 and QFN28 packages.
CH9102 supports built-in CDC driver in operating system or multi-functional high-speed VCP manufacture driver.

relationFileList.name: CH9103DS1.PDF
relationFileList.content: CH9103 datasheet, USB to dual serial ports, supports up to 3M baud rate, serial port signals support 5V/3.3V/2.5V/1.8V,  provides RS485 direction control and GPIO and other signal pins, built-in crystal oscillator, QFN40 package. Built-in Unique USB Serial Number, supports USB parameters configuration. CH9103 supports built-in CDC driver in operating system or multi-functional high-speed VCP manufacture driver.
